name: Hello
description: Open hand waving side to side — friendly greeting.

name: Goodbye
description: Open hand waving downward or closing — farewell signal.

name: Thank You
description: Fingertips to chin moving forward — gratitude sign.

name: Please
description: Open palm placed over chest in a circular motion.

name: Welcome
description: Open hands gesturing inward — warm welcome.

name: Nice to meet you
description: Both index fingers meeting in front of chest.

name: Water
description: W-shape with index, middle, ring finger tapping chin.

name: Food / Eat
description: Flattened O-hand tapping mouth — requesting food.

name: Bathroom
description: T-shape hand shaking side to side.

name: Help
description: Closed fist with thumb up resting on flat palm.

name: More
description: Fingertips of both hands tapping together.

name: Done / Finished
description: Both open hands turning outward — task complete.

name: Need
description: Bent X-hand moving down downward twice.

name: Want
description: Open palms facing up pulling toward body.

name: Sleep
description: Open palm drawing down over face to closed fist.

name: Wash Hands
description: Rubbing palms together in a circular motion.

name: Emergency
description: E-hand shape shaking vigorously back and forth.

name: Stop
description: Open vertical palm facing camera — immediate halt.

name: Pain / Hurt
description: Index fingers pointing toward each other twisting.

name: Danger
description: Strict warning gesture with index finger raised.

name: Doctor
description: Tapping wrist pulse with index and middle fingers.

name: Police
description: C-shape hand placed over left chest badge location.

name: Fire
description: Wiggling fingers moving upward like flames.

name: Take Care
description: K-hands stacked on top of each other tapping.

name: Zero (0)
description: O-shape formed with thumb and fingers.

name: One (1)
description: Single index finger pointing upward.

name: Two (2)
description: Index and middle fingers extended upward.

name: Three (3)
description: Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended.

name: Four (4)
description: Four fingers raised with thumb tucked in.

name: Five (5)
description: All five digits fully extended.

name: Six (6)
description: Pinky touching thumb with 3 fingers raised.

name: Seven (7)
description: Ring finger touching thumb with other fingers raised.

name: Eight (8)
description: Middle finger touching thumb with other fingers raised.

name: Nine (9)
description: Index finger touching thumb forming a circle.

name: Yes
description: S-fist nodding up and down like a head nod.

name: No
description: Index and middle finger snapping onto thumb.

name: OK
description: Thumb and index in circle with 3 fingers raised.

name: Maybe
description: Palms facing up weighing options back and forth.

name: Understand
description: Index finger flicking up near forehead.

name: Good
description: Fingertips from lips moving to palm of other hand.

name: Bad
description: Fingertips from lips turning palm down.

name: Wait
description: Both hands wiggling fingers in place.
